indicator_definition: Gini coefficient measuring inequality in the distribution of equivalised disposable income. Ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 100 (maximum inequality). Data collected through EU-SILC.
rationale: Income inequality limits opportunities and social mobility. Progress means a declining Gini coefficient reflecting more equal income distribution.
methodology_characteristics: Data collected through EU-SILC. Gini coefficient calculated from the full income distribution using equivalised disposable income. Published annually by Eurostat.
indicator_name: Gini coefficient of equivalised disposable income
graph_title: Gini coefficient of equivalised disposable income
